user.title: To-do Sync
user.description: Choose two to-do lists whose open items should be synchronized. Set the sync interval and optional cleanup and title handling below. You can change these settings later.

data.split_title: Automatically split titles into name and description

data_description.interval: How often To-do Sync checks both lists automatically.
data_description.remove_duplicates: Enabled by default for new setups. Completes extra open copies of the same item, keeping one open copy per list. Each extra copy must have a unique provider UID; if the provider cannot identify it safely, synchronization stops and this option must be disabled for that list pair.
data_description.split_title: For lists without description support, use the first word as the item name and the rest as its description. Turn this off to keep the full title as the item name.

reconfigure.title: Reconfigure To-do Sync
reconfigure.description: Choose the two lists to synchronize. Changing either list resets the saved sync baseline and pending write tracking; the current contents of the selected lists will be synchronized again.

error.entity_not_found: One or both selected to-do lists are not currently available.

abort.already_configured: This pair of lists is already configured.

init.title: To-do Sync
init.description: For lists without description support, the first word becomes the item name and the rest becomes its description. Disable this option to keep the complete title intact.
